code_generation.title: Senior Python Engineer Task
code_generation.example:
Role: You are a Senior Python Developer specializing in asynchronous web scraping and performance optimization.
Task: Write a complete, tested, high-performance Python function using the 'httpx' library to fetch data from 10 external API endpoints concurrently.
Context: This function powers a critical data aggregation service with a strict 500ms response time requirement.
Constraints: Include type hints for all arguments and return values. Implement comprehensive error handling for timeouts, 404s, and 500s. Return results as a list of validated Pydantic objects. Add inline comments using chain-of-thought style to clarify your reasoning at each step.
code_generation.instructions: Incorporate explicit programming languages and libraries into the TASK. Define measurable performance and security targets. Mandate clear input/output formats (JSON, Models) in the CONSTRAINTS. Use technical action verbs like 'initialize', 'optimize', 'sanitize'.
code_generation.exemplar_output:
```python
async def fetch_concurrent(urls: list[str]) -> list[dict | None]:
    """Fetches all URLs concurrently. Returns None for failed requests."""
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30.0) as client:
        return await asyncio.gather(*[_fetch_one(client, url) for url in urls])
```
Each function begins with a docstring, uses type hints, and handles exceptions at the call site rather than silently swallowing them.

formal_email.title: Diplomatic HR Communications Expert
formal_email.example:
Role: You are an HR Communications Specialist skilled in writing diplomatic, clear, and actionable internal announcements.
Task: Draft a formal, positive email announcing a mandatory 4-hour system maintenance period that will affect all user access.
Context: Inform the entire company without causing alarm, emphasizing improved security as the primary benefit.
Constraints: Use a professional yet warm tone. Keep the body under 150 words. Bold the exact date and time. Include one clear action item for employees. Provide a contact for questions. Structure the announcement logically using chain-of-thought reasoning to ensure coherence and reassurance.
formal_email.instructions: Inject diplomatic and purpose-driven language. Mandate a specific tone (e.g., 'Authoritative yet Empathetic'). Ensure the CONSTRAINTS section includes mandatory layout elements like 'Clear Call-to-Action' and 'Contact Point'.
formal_email.exemplar_output:
Subject: Scheduled Maintenance — Saturday 11 PM–2 AM (No Action Required)

Dear Team, Our platform will be offline Saturday from 11:00 PM to 2:00 AM EST. This upgrade cuts page-load times by 40% and resolves the SSO issue reported since March. No files will be lost. If you need access during this window, contact it-support@company.com by Friday 5 PM.

marketing_campaign.title: Growth-Focused Digital Strategy Director
marketing_campaign.example:
Role: You are a Digital Strategy Director for a direct-to-consumer wellness brand, specializing in viral marketing and measurable growth campaigns.
Task: Create three distinct social media posts to launch a new line of organic protein bars.
Context: Target health-conscious professionals aged 25-40. The campaign goal is a 10% increase in website traffic during the first week.
Constraints: The Instagram Reel must be a 15-second visual concept. The X thread must tag two industry leaders. The LinkedIn post must include a valuable insight about food science.
marketing_campaign.instructions: Expand the Audience into a detailed psychographic profile. Inject measurable KPIs (Conversions, CTR) into the TASK. Mandate platform-specific formatting and viral hooks in the CONSTRAINTS.
marketing_campaign.exemplar_output:
Goal: Reduce checkout abandonment by 15% for the Q4 'Mindful Morning' collection.
Channel: Retargeting Email Sequence (3 parts).
Segment A (The Skeptic): '73% of your cart items are waiting. Here is the 10-second reason why they belong in your kitchen: [Specific Nutrient Density Claim].'
Mechanism: Social proof aggregate (12k+ reviews) + Scarcity (batch-limited supply).
Constraint: Zero 'act now' or 'don't miss out' genericisms. Replace with: 'Shipment departs in 4 hours.'

image_generation.title: Cinematic Visual Director Prompt
image_generation.example:
Role: You are a cinematic director creating a highly descriptive prompt for Midjourney or Stable Diffusion.
Task: Generate a hyper-realistic photograph of a lone medieval knight standing on a wind-swept cliff overlooking a turbulent, foggy ocean at sunset.
Context: The image should evoke isolation, determination, and epic fantasy.
Constraints: Use 16:9 aspect ratio. Specify 'photorealistic', 'Unreal Engine 5', 'volumetric lighting', and 'golden hour'. Ensure the knight's armor is highly detailed and rusted.
image_generation.instructions: Inject technical rendering terms (Ray Tracing, Volumetric Lighting) and specific aspect ratios. Enrich the ROLE with a specific artistic style or era. Use visual-first language in the TASK.
image_generation.exemplar_output: A lone lighthouse keeper at the edge of a basalt sea cliff, golden-hour silhouette razor-sharp against storm-split amber sky. Shot on Hasselblad X2D 100C, 85mm, f/1.8, volumetric god rays piercing cloud gaps. Photorealistic, 8K, cinematic 2.39:1, Unreal Engine 5, hyperdetailed weathered oilskin coat and salt-crusted boots.

general.title: General Purpose Prompt Expert
general.example:
Role: You are a versatile AI assistant who clarifies and organizes any user request.
Task: Break down the user's request into clear objectives, deliverables, and success criteria.
Context: The user's request may be vague or broad.
Constraints: Identify the target audience and core problem. Set a clear output format. Use chain-of-thought reasoning.
general.instructions: Clarify objectives into specific deliverables. Use Chain-of-Thought reasoning to bridge input gaps. Mandate a clear success criterion and output structure in the CONSTRAINTS.
general.exemplar_output:
**Objective**: Generate three pitch-deck slide concepts for a Series A fundraise.
**Format**: [Slide Title] → [One-sentence investor narrative] → [Key visual element].
**Success Criteria**: Each slide answers one investor question without requiring verbal explanation from the presenter.

blog.title: Thought-Leadership & SEO Content Strategist
blog.example:
Role: You are a Senior Content Strategist and SEO Copywriter with expertise in making complex technical topics accessible and viral.
Task: Create a 1,500-word deep-dive blog post titled 'The Future of Quantum Computing for Beginners'.
Context: Target tech-curious professionals and high school students.
Constraints: Use a conversational yet authoritative tone. Include three catchy subheadings (H2). Embed one 'Real-World Analogy' for every major technical point. Optimize for the keyword 'Quantum Basics'.
blog.instructions: Inject SEO-focused mandates (Keywords, Meta-tags) and structural requirements (H2, H3 tags). Force a specific 'Hook' in the ROLE. Mandate a readability score or specific educational framework in the CONSTRAINTS.
blog.exemplar_output: Your gut contains 38 trillion bacteria — more than the number of human cells in your body. By Wednesday of most diet studies, that population has already shifted enough to measurably change your insulin response. Here's what that means for what you eat tonight: [structured breakdown using Feynman analogies follows].

creative_writing.title: Imaginative Storytelling Mentor
creative_writing.example:
Role: You are an imaginative creative writing mentor skilled in crafting rich narrative prompts.
Task: Develop a detailed prompt for generating the opening chapter of a mystery novel.
Context: The user wants a scene with deep atmosphere and a compelling protagonist.
Constraints: Define the genre and tone. Describe at least two main characters with motivations. Outline the setting with vivid sensory detail. Include an inciting incident.
creative_writing.instructions: Enrich the ROLE with a specific literary voice or genre mastery. Deepen the CONTEXT with character motivations and world-building conflicts. Mandate sensory details and specific narrative structures in the CONSTRAINTS.
creative_writing.exemplar_output: The letter arrived three weeks after Marcus died — postmarked from a city he'd never visited, signed in handwriting that matched his exactly. Detective Chen set it beside her cold coffee and the department's official verdict: natural causes. She read it twice, then a third time, before she understood what it was asking her to do.
